svg.title: Build a flyer checker from a tested prompt
svg.desc: A flyer checker should show what the flyer says and flag any missing detail before someone uses it. Try the rule. In Playground, ask for the flyer title, date and showtimes. Shape the answer. Give each value a named field. Use null when the date is missing. Build a preview. Keep the flyer beside the extracted facts so a reader can check each one.
svg.text: Build a flyer checker from a tested prompt
A flyer checker should show what the flyer says and flag any missing detail
In Playground, ask for the flyer title, date and showtimes.
Give each value a named field. Use null when the date is missing.
Keep the flyer beside the extracted facts so a reader can check each one.
